body.statement: Every finite graph family used for the feasibility, dense-endpoint, directed-tree, and cycle-free transcript lower bounds admits strictly positive binary component kernels \(\boldsymbol\kappa\), positive mixture weights \(\mathbf w\), and strictly positive shared target laws \(\mathbf q\) such that the induced laws \(P_\ell\), \(P_{\ell,I}\), and \(P_I\) satisfy \(\Delta(\mathbf G,\boldsymbol\kappa)=V\), every declared true edge is active in its child kernel, and simultaneous I-mixture faithfulness holds for every \(I\subseteq V\).
body.justification: A graphical lower pair is legally relevant to the population oracle only if compatible faithful mechanisms exist for all queried interventions.
body.gap: The anchor's local necessity examples and the presolve fixtures do not supply an all-parameter simultaneous-faithfulness theorem under padding and topology replication.
body.consumer: The theorem turns every graphical transcript adversary into a valid population-level impossibility result under the stated bridge.
